university-of-florida.quote: Beds may not be elevated from the floor by cinder blocks or any means other than bunk bed units provided by Housing & Residence Life.

university-of-florida.title: Community Standards (UF Housing & Residence Life)
university-of-florida.quote: Personal dishwashers, dryers, waterbeds and personally constructed lofts of any type are prohibited in rooms/ apartments.

university-of-miami.title: Fall Move-In for New Students (UM Housing & Residential Life)
university-of-miami.quote: The University has ended its partnership with BedLoft (including its MicroFridge rental program) and will no longer allow students to loft their beds.

university-of-miami.title: Centennial Village (UM Housing & Residential Life)
university-of-miami.quote: *The University has ended its partnership with BedLoft and will no longer allow students to loft their beds. Bed risers are allowed.

university-of-miami.title: Guide to Living On Campus (UM Housing & Residential Life)
university-of-miami.quote: Students may use bed risers; however, they may not lift the bed higher than 24" off the ground. Students can only have 24 inches total of storage space under the bed.

university-of-miami.title: Guide to Living On Campus (UM Housing & Residential Life)
university-of-miami.quote: You may not paint, build lofts, hang flags, or the like from ceilings or on the walls as these are fire hazards.

university-of-michigan.title: Housing Terms and Conditions, Academic Year 2025-2026 (Michigan Housing)
university-of-michigan.quote: Most residence hall rooms and some apartments are outfitted with modular furniture

university-of-michigan.title: Housing Terms and Conditions, Academic Year 2025-2026 (Michigan Housing)
university-of-michigan.quote: All furniture must be assembled and used according to the manufacturer's approved configurations (e.g., the guardrails provided must be used for an upper bunk or loft unit, bed risers and other materials that elevate the bed or other modular furniture elements are not permitted.)

university-of-michigan.title: Housing Terms and Conditions, Academic Year 2025-2026 (Michigan Housing)
Housing Terms and Conditions, Academic Year 2025-2026 (Michigan Housing)
Housing Terms and Conditions, Academic Year 2025-2026 (Michigan Housing)

uno.title: Pontchartrain Halls Housing Agreement 2025/2026 (Office of Residential Life, linked from uno.edu/media/4211/download)
uno.quote: Students shall make no alterations, improvements, or additions to the premises without prior written approval of the Office of Residential Life professional staff.

uno.title: Pontchartrain Halls Housing Agreement 2025/2026 (Office of Residential Life, linked from uno.edu/media/4211/download)
uno.quote: Additional furniture may not be added to the room, suite or common areas without written permission from the Office of Residential Life professional staff.

upenn.title: Policies (Penn Residential Services)
upenn.quote: Residents are not permitted to bunk or loft their beds. Residential Services may loft or bunk beds in situations where room size means the room will not properly function without lofting or bunking. Residents who believe their room may need lofting or bunking may have their room assessed by putting a work order in with Facilities.

upenn.title: Policies (Penn Residential Services)
upenn.quote: This includes the careless use of appliances or materials, tampering with internet hard wired or wireless devices, and installation of partitions or lofts.

usao.title: 2025-2026 USAO Housing Guide
usao.quote: Residents may use commercial bed risers to raise bed frames. These risers may not exceed 12 inches in height. Only commercial bed risers are permitted; cinder blocks and other homemade devices are prohibited. Stacking bed risers is also prohibited.

usc.title: Resident Information Move-In Guide 2023-2024 (USC Housing)
usc.quote: Residents may not bunk or loft beds themselves and should check with their CSC to see if this can be done in their room once they have moved in.

usc.title: 2024-2025 Housing Services Contract and Living Agreement (USC Housing)
usc.quote: The Resident may not utilize additional supports or brackets not provided by the University to reconfigure furniture from its original state (e.g. lofting beds).

ut-austin.title: Jester West - Virtual Tours
ut-austin.quote: Can I loft or bunk my bed? Yes you can. All the furniture in Jester West is moveable.

ut-austin.title: Brackenridge Hall - Virtual Tours
ut-austin.quote: Can I loft or bunk my bed? Yes you can. All furniture in Brackenridge is moveable.

ut-austin.title: Blanton Hall - Virtual Tours
ut-austin.quote: Residents of basement-level rooms in Blanton can choose to have their beds either bunked or lofted. Beds on the first through fifth floors are not bunkable, but you can choose to have the height of your bed adjusted.

ut-austin.title: Andrews Hall - Virtual Tours
ut-austin.quote: Residents of basement-level rooms in Andrews can choose to have their beds either bunked (one bed above the other) or lofted. Beds on the first through third floors cannot be lofted, but you and your roommate can choose to have them bunked.

ut-austin.title: Carothers Hall - Virtual Tours
ut-austin.quote: Residents of basement-level rooms in Carothers can choose to have their beds either bunked (one bed above the other) or lofted (adjusting the height of a separate, un-bunked bed). Beds on the first through fourth floors cannot be lofted, but you and your roommate can choose to have them bunked.

ut-chattanooga.title: UTC Housing and Residence Life Contract 2024-2025
West Campus
ut-chattanooga.quote: Bed ends have nine adjustable heights, highest is approx. 36 inches off the floor. If on the highest setting, the bottom of the mattress is approx. 30" to the floor. Lofting of bed is not permitted.

uva.title: What New Wahoo Parents Are Asking the Most on Facebook (UVA Today)
uva.quote: The rooms have a bed that can be lofted, a mattress, a desk, a dresser, a wardrobe, and a trash can for each occupant.

uw.title: Set Up Your Space - UW HFS
uw.quote: Many students like to loft their bed to create additional space underneath for storage or their desks. In buildings with metal beds, you can change the height of the bed to suit your needs. When you move out, please make sure all furnishings are arranged according to the original layout. For metal beds, this includes resetting the original bed height to the second rung from the bottom.

uw.title: About 9-month housing - UW HFS (image captions)
uw.quote: Bunkbeds in Mercer Court double room. Bunk beds in McCarty Hall tripe room

uw.title: McCarty Hall double room - UW HFS
uw.quote: The additional furniture will include an additional desk, chair, and drawer set and may include an additional bed.

uw-madison.title: Inside Our Rooms
uw-madison.quote: All provided furniture is able to be lofted or bunked. Bed parts to adjust bed heights to mid-loft and lofted are included in each resident room. Housing staff are not available during move-in to loft beds. Residents and families are encouraged to loft their own beds during move-in. If residents would like assistance lofting their bed after move-in, a maintenance request can be submitted after move-in. If the room is a triple, quad, or hextuple, then beds are bunked at normal heights with side rails attached to the top bunk. Most rooms in Waters have building block style furniture. All other residence hall rooms have a mix of the upright styles of loftable furniture.

uw-madison.title: Rules & Expectations
uw-madison.quote: Loft system furniture is provided in all halls; students may not bring or assemble their own loft.

vanderbilt.title: Residence Life Revealed: Webinar for the Class of 2029 Q&A
vanderbilt.quote: How do students adjust the height of the bed? Beds in The Ingram Commons houses are loftable. Information on how to loft or unloft the bed is available at vanderbilt.edu/ohare/video-how-to-unloft-and-loft-your-bed/.

vanderbilt.title: Administrative Policies - Vanderbilt Student Handbook
vanderbilt.quote: Weightlifting equipment, water beds, hot tubs, lofts, and bunk beds (other than those provided by the University), unauthorized construction of walls and partitions, satellite dishes and antennae are prohibited.

vanderbilt.title: 2016-17 Move-In and Housing Guide for First-Year Students
vanderbilt.quote: What Not To Bring: Bed risers or loft (Beds at The Ingram Commons are ready made for lofting to various heights up to 4'.)

vcu.title: Honors - Move-in
vcu.quote: What Not To Bring: Cinder blocks, loft equipment, bed risers or any other equipment/items used to adjust bed height

vcu.title: Grace & Broad - Move-in
vcu.quote: What Not To Bring: Cinder blocks, loft equipment, bed risers or any other equipment/items used to adjust bed height

vcu.title: 2026-2027 Guide to Residential Living
vcu.quote: RLH specifically prohibits the following general categories and examples of items in the residence halls unless the university has provided an item for resident use. Furniture: Cinder Blocks, Hot Tubs, Loft Equipment/Bed Lofts, Pools, Waterbeds

vcu.title: Move-in
vcu.quote: Unlofting Beds (Rhoads, Brandt, and Grace & Broad)

vcu.title: Brandt
vcu.quote: Low-loft extra long twin bed (36" x 80")

vcu.title: Gladding Residence Center III
vcu.quote: Low-loft extra long twin bed (36" x 80")

virginia-tech.title: Housing Policies - Virginia Tech Housing Services
virginia-tech.quote: Lofts are elevated beds that allow students to store items or place their desk under the bed. All rooms with twin beds have loftable furniture. Outside (self-built/purchased/rented) lofts are not permitted. The use of "bed risers" or other elevating materials in conjunction with the beds may create an unstable situation and are not allowed. In Slusher Wing, due to the room configuration with built-in cabinetry, only one bed may be placed in the high/lofted configuration. This exclusion applies to rooms 201 through 231, 301 through 331, and 401 through 431.

virginia-tech.title: Housing Policies - Virginia Tech Housing Services (furnishings)
virginia-tech.quote: Most rooms are furnished with a medicine cabinet and/or mirror, sink, two beds (often bunked), two mattresses, two desks, two desk chairs, and clothing storage

virginia-tech.title: Move-In - Virginia Tech Housing
virginia-tech.quote: All resident rooms have university-provided, loftable furniture. Students will use a "loft kit" to raise their bed to the higher setting. Most rooms already have 2 loft kits in the room. If an additional loft kit is needed, students should submit a work order to have the kit delivered. Loft kits are limited so turn in your request promptly. Bed configurations in the Corps of Cadets residential areas must follow the directions of the Corps regulations and staff.

western-oregon.title: WOU Spec Sheet for Residence Hall Furniture & Storage Space (2018)
western-oregon.quote: BEDS (All Halls): MOVEABLE: Yes. STACKABLE: Yes, with restrictions. STORAGE BENEATH: Yes, variable. Depending upon how high the bed is lofted, Storage beneath the bed varies from a minimum of 12" to a maximum of 31".

western-oregon.title: The Guide to Residential Living 2025-2026
western-oregon.quote: 17. Unapproved Lofts: Construction of stilts, lofts, or platforms or use of concrete blocks or other bunking structures for your bed except where the furniture has been specifically designed for that purpose.

western-oregon.title: WOU Suggested Packing List
western-oregon.quote: DO NOT BRING: Any non-university bed frame or loft

western-oregon.title: 2025-2026 Housing Contract
western-oregon.quote: Ready means that you may only use half of the room and that the following room amenities for the other side of the room have no personal belongings: bed, desk, drawers, wardrobe/closet, bookshelf, and chair. Beds may not be bunked and furniture cannot be combined in any way.

western-washington.title: Maintenance & Amenities
western-washington.quote: Lofted or bunked beds are typically available only in: Triple rooms where space constraints require loft and/or bunk set-ups. Beds that are tool free can be adjusted at varying heights from Low Single to High Single (Captain) configuration. Low single and high single (captain) beds are available in all communities. In the Birnam Wood Apartments, each apartment's storage closet contains bed parts to support all bed configurations. High bed configurations must use UR bed parts and are only authorized after approval from UR facilities. For high bed configurations, a bed safety rail & ladder is typically provided per bed. Residents are required to use this for their personal safety. Students may use certified bed risers up to 12" to increase storage space under bed.

western-washington.title: Prohibited Items
western-washington.quote: one set of store-bought bed risers, measuring up to 12 inches with a broad base, are permitted (multiple sets cannot be stacked on each other). Non-university mattresses, non-university beds, and non-university bed parts (unless through an approved university accommodation). homemade bed risers / modifications, water-filled mattresses, and wood, bricks or cement blocks used to prop beds.

western-washington.title: Mathes Community
western-washington.quote: Bed Storage Space (Inches): Low/High Single : 8.2 - 30.7. Loft: desks fit comfortably underneath - actual size varies. Bunk: 8.25

wustl.title: Lofted Furniture - Residential Life
wustl.quote: The Office of Residential Life permits students to use their own loft furniture. However, lofts must be approved by the Facilities & Services Coordinator in Residential Life. The Office of Residential Life reserves the right to ask students to remove a loft if it is deemed unsafe.

wustl.title: First-Year Housing - Residential Life
wustl.quote: All rooms include the following for each resident: Bed frame; Highest height: 36-inches from floor; Extra long twin mattress (36"x80")

yale.title: New Student FAQs - Yale College
yale.quote: Can the bed be bunked or debunked? Yes, if there is enough room for two beds in the room. How much space is under the bed? 12-36. If the bed is raised, students can fit their dresser under the bed.

yale.title: Housing - Undergraduate Regulations, Yale University
yale.quote: Students may not make alterations to their rooms. No lofts or partitions of any kind may be constructed.
